claims: The Orion spacecraft is NASA's crew exploration vehicle for the Artemis program.
The Orion spacecraft is designed to carry four astronauts on deep-space missions, including lunar orbit and future Mars missions.
The Orion spacecraft is a 67-foot-tall, three-part capsule.
The Orion spacecraft consists of launch abort, crew, and service modules.
The Orion spacecraft is built to handle deep space radiation.
The Orion spacecraft is built to handle high-speed atmospheric re-entry.
The first crewed flight of the Orion spacecraft is Artemis II.
